newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends slightly off in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends slightly off in quiet session.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0527 real per dollar in a listless session in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $48.4 million.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real also ended off 0.01 percent at 1.0576 real per greenback, they added.
In the illegal parallel market the real closed flat at 1.085 real per dollar.
